completeness.why: copyPreviousMonth and setZero route the whole selection through shouldFillCategory with an explicit hiddenPolicy, and both sign sites use averageToBudgetAmount; the three average actions call shouldFillCategory('require-visible') but their SQL still filters c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0, so the hidden rule is still decided at those sites (twice).

interface.why: A named three-way hiddenPolicy makes the preserved inconsistencies (setZero includes hidden, copy skips only flagged-hidden, averages require known-visible groups) explicit without speculative options; isTrackingBudget is passed in by every caller though it is a global the helper could read itself.

disguised_duplication.where: set3/6/12MonthAvg in server/budget/actions.ts keep the hidden filter in their SQL WHERE clause while the 'require-visible' policy re-checks the same rule in fill-rules.ts; the three identical category queries remain copied
